"I have loved you, says the Lord. But you say, 'How have you loved us?'" How has God shown his love to you?
The priests offered blemished sacrifices. How can we give God our leftovers instead of our best?
"From the rising of the sun to its setting my name will be great among the nations." How can you make God's name great?
Levi walked with God in peace and uprightness and turned many from iniquity. How can you walk with God like this?
"Have we not all one Father? Has not one God created us?" How should this shape how we treat each other?
"Guard yourselves in your spirit, and let none of you be faithless." How can you guard faithfulness in relationships?
God would send his messenger to prepare the way. How does this point to John the Baptist and Jesus?
"I the Lord do not change." What comfort is there in God's unchanging nature?
"Return to me, and I will return to you." What does returning to God look like?
"Bring the full tithe into the storehouse... and see if I will not open the windows of heaven." How do you trust God with your giving?
Those who feared the Lord spoke with one another, and God wrote a book of remembrance. What does God remember about you?
"For you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness shall rise with healing in its wings." Where do you need God's healing?
God would turn the hearts of fathers to their children. How can God heal relationships in your family?
